x: In the final Match our sprint relay squad just held off a classy Southampton squad, broke the Div 3 record & sliced a huge 1.2 secs off the Club record. Todd hands to Roger Black and Ernie to Phil Goedluck.

Held in very windy conditions which affected times in all track events, John stormed round the bend into a 3.5 m/s wind and then eased as he approached the tape, comfortably holding off Michael Rosswess and Roger Black to win in 21.24 sec.

His time of 31.99 put him well ahead of Roger Black, the previous holder of the "record". Then came another slightly disappointing performance at the European Cup where John did not like being pushed into 2nd spot by France's Trouabal.

Intermittent rain returned today, together with high humidity, but there was plenty to cheer about from a British point of view today with Sally Gunnell's and Tony Jarrett's hurdles runs and Roger Black's 400 metres.
1, GBR (R.Black 44.7, D.Redmond 44.0, J.Regis 44.22, K.Akabusi 44.59) 2:57.53 (European, Commonwealth and Championship Records; 4th fastest of all time); 2, USA 2:57.57; 3, JAM 3:00.10.
Roger Black and Derek Redmond have done their work well and now it is up to John Regis to keep breathing down the neck of the USA's Danny Everett.
